The Charlotte Hornets (1-1, 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back, 8th in the East) host the Miami Heat (0-2, 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, 15th in the East) in the third game of the 2026-27 season for Charlotte. The Hornets have lost their only home game and won their only road game so far, while Miami has lost both of its games, both at home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though Charlotte lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3 and beat Miami 136-106 in Charlotte on March 17, 2026, the most recent meeting.

Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell are out for Charlotte, and Coby White is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision. Miami's Pelle Larsson is also day-to-day with a finger sprain and a game-time decision.
